mainEntity.name: How do I open a chapter in a new tab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press + at the end of the tab strip, or Ctrl/⌘-press a reference. Tabs reorder by dragging.

mainEntity.name: How do I open a tab in its own window?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drag a tab down out of the strip, or double-click it. Drag its bar back over the strip to dock it.

mainEntity.name: How do I hide or show a sidebar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ctrl/⌘ B hides or shows the left sidebar; the buttons at the right of the band do both sides.
The Shortcuts page lists every key this build binds and the words the palette understands.
